major_cooldowns.name: Thunder Focus Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Off the global cooldown and castable through a Soothing Mist channel: spend it on Renewing Mist for the 10 second HoT extension and the Secret Infusion haste, on Enveloping Mist when one target needs a large instant heal, or on Rising Sun Kick for the 9 second cooldown cut and Versatility during a defensive moment.

major_cooldowns.name: Life Cocoon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Instant, off the global cooldown, and it will not break Soothing Mist on the same target: drop the 12 second absorb on anyone about to die, since it also raises their healing over time received by 50%.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Ramp into the damage event: get the Secret Infusion haste buff up and spend all Renewing Mist charges first, then summon Yu'lon and rotate Enveloping Mists across the raid, pressing Rising Sun Kick after 3-4 of them to extend the HoTs and filling with Vivify.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The mana-friendly raid cooldown: open it with a Blackout Kick to spend the 4 Teachings of the Monastery stacks into as many targets as possible, then weave Enveloping Mists ahead of incoming damage and extend them with Rising Sun Kick.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Conduit of the Celestials burst window: hold the 4 second channel for a known raid damage spike and recast it through Unity Within to bring every August Celestial in at 200% effectiveness.

major_cooldowns.name: Revival
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: A 40 yard raid-wide heal that also procs Mastery: Gust of Mists on everyone it hits and strips Magic, Poison and Disease, so save it for a stacked damage event or for a raid-wide dispel.

major_cooldowns.name: Restoral
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take this over Revival when a Magic dispel would wipe the raid: the same raid-wide heal without the Magic cleanse, and it stays castable while stunned.

rule.description: Thunder Focus Tea spent on Renewing Mist
rule.action: Follow almost every Thunder Focus Tea with Renewing Mist for the 10 second duration extension and the Secret Infusion haste; only spend it on Enveloping Mist when one target needs the instant burst heal.

rule.description: Blackout Kick right after Invoke Chi-Ji
rule.action: Chi-Ji hands you 4 Teachings of the Monastery stacks, so open the summon with a Blackout Kick into as many targets as you can reach before doing anything else.

rule.description: Enveloping Mist chained inside Invoke Yu'lon
rule.action: Yu'lon cuts Enveloping Mist cast time by 30%, so rotate Enveloping Mists across the raid the moment it lands, then Rising Sun Kick after 3-4 of them to extend every HoT.

rule.description: Strength of the Black Ox into Enveloping Mist
rule.action: Spend every Strength of the Black Ox on an Enveloping Mist: it halves the cast time and shields 5 nearby allies.
Keep Renewing Mist rolling at all times and never sit on 3 charges; it drives your Mastery procs, your tier bonus and your Rising Sun Kick extensions.

rule.description: Spinning Crane Kick on 4 or more enemies
rule.action: Save Spinning Crane Kick for 4 or more enemies, where Way of the Crane turns it into the bulk of your throughput; on fewer targets use Tiger Palm into Blackout Kick instead.
